Sarah (CS): Quick check — HelioMed onboarding flagged a latency SLO miss yesterday. Customer wants clarity on whether they qualify for a credit and what evidence we need.
Mike (Support Eng): Saw the ticket. 95th went to ~780ms for ~45m around 03:20 UTC.
Laura (SRE): Confirmed in traces — spike tied to a model rollout that had heavier context lengths. We rolled back at 03:45.
Jordan (PM): Do we have a playbook for pre-renewal credit calculations? HelioMed is mid-contract, asking for a formal rationale.
Ana (DevEx): We have the credit calc doc but it's a bit ops-heavy. Link: https://redwood.example/docs/slo-crediting (internal) — might need a one-pager for CS to send.
Sarah (CS): Can someone paste the 30m window metrics and the exact SLO definition we applied? I need to pack it with the evidence bundle.
Laura (SRE): SLO = 95th latency < 500ms per minute for the service route `/v1/generate`. Policy: rolling 30-day evaluation, but credits trigger on sustained window > 15m below target.
Laura (SRE): Quick excerpt from the query I ran: ```sql
SELECT
  floor(extract(epoch from time)/60) AS minute,
  percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS p95
FROM api_latency
WHERE route = '/v1/generate' AND time BETWEEN '2026-03-18T03:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-18T04:00:00Z'
GROUP BY minute
ORDER BY minute;
```
Mike (Support Eng): Raw snippet (p95): 480, 510, 525, 610, 700, 780, 770, 400, 360 — peak around 03:20-03:35.
Sarah (CS): Perfect. For HelioMed I also need: authentication of customer traffic (to show it's their routes), and a short summary of mitigation steps.
Jordan (PM): Mitigation: we automatic-rollbacked the canary and deployed a tuned quantized variant. Laura, can you confirm timing and which variant?
Laura (SRE): Rolled back at 03:45 UTC. Canary model sha: `m-2026-03-17-q2`; fallback to `m-2026-03-17-q1` (quantized). Added throttling rule to cap batch sizes for the route.
Ana (DevEx): I can make a 1-page summary for CS: bullet points (what happened, metric snippets, what we changed, recommended customer mitigations).
Sarah (CS): Great. OpsBot — can you attach the evidence bundle (traces + query results + deploy diff) to the HelioMed ticket now? @OpsBot
OpsBot: Uploaded evidence bundle to ticket HEL-9123: /artifacts/HEL-9123/evidence-1758123456.zip :white_check_mark:
Mike (Support Eng): Also note: HelioMed had a spike of longer prompts at that time (they enabled debug-mode) — logs show average tokens/request rose ~2.6x.
Jordan (PM): That matters for the narrative. If it's customer-driven load that exceeded expected profile, credit calc might differ. Sarah, do you want us to draft two narratives (operator-side cause vs customer-load cause)?
Sarah (CS): Yes. Please draft both. We prefer the operator-side credit if it's on us; if it's on customer usage pattern, we offer guidance instead of credit.
Laura (SRE): I'll add a short trace comparison: requests with tokens>2048 vs normal distribution, and a note about how batching interacts with long-context overhead.
Ana (DevEx): ETA 3h for the one-pager + attached graphs.
Mike (Support Eng): I'll add the raw aggregated CSV to the bundle: columns -> minute,p95_ms,requests,avg_tokens.
Sarah (CS): Action items: 1) Laura: trace + deploy timeline (by EOD). 2) Mike: CSV + logs (by EOD). 3) Ana: CS one-pager (3h). 4) Jordan: draft two narratives (by EOD). I will synthesize and send a comms draft to HelioMed.
Jordan (PM): Noted. I'll start the drafts now.
Laura (SRE): One more ask — legal wants the calculation proof in case they push for formal credits. I'll include the exact SQL + retention snapshot.
Sarah (CS): Thanks team. If we can confirm whether the spike correlates to an enabled debug flag, flag it in the HelioMed message — honesty helps.
Mike (Support Eng): Yup, debug flag enabled at 02:58 UTC per their request log. I'll highlight it.
Sarah (CS): Closing loop: I'll hold on emailing until we have the one-pager and the two narratives. Tentative send window tomorrow 15:00 PDT.
Ana (DevEx): I'll ping here once the PDF is uploaded. :rocket:
Sarah (CS): Thanks all — this is a good enablement checkpoint for future pre-renewal SLO comms.
